findings.detail: Confirmed: user rollback deletes pending invitations by every uploaded email without preserving whether they predated the job, while Site rollback cannot restore retired slots, detached unit associations, or cleared notes. Persist exact before-state and job-owned changes, restore them transactionally, add changed/pre-existing-row rollback tests, and confirm the destructive UI action.

Confirmed: the Communities tab calls /v1/sites export/import even though Community is defined as tenant and Site is a child parking facility; replace mode can retire Sites but cannot import community identity or community address/notes. Implement Community-level bulk operations or relabel this as Sites and explicitly complete the unmet Community requirement.

Confirmed: GET /v1/me omits notify_guest_events, while EditProfile initializes the toggle to true and always submits it. Return and rehydrate the saved preference so changing name, phone, or avatar cannot silently re-enable guest notifications.

Confirmed: Resident disclosure buttons are removed from tab order, collapsed-menu selectors and Sign out remain focusable while visually clipped, and new tab widgets advertise incomplete ARIA tab semantics. Restore visible keyboard traversal and either implement the full tabs pattern or use ordinary button groups.

findings.summary: Resident deep links only work on mount
findings.detail: Confirmed: ?edit=1 and #new seed local state once, so navigating via the new sidebar children while ResidentHome is already mounted does not open or focus the destination. Synchronize state with router location and test in-place navigation in both directions.

Confirmed: a successful pass lookup never navigates to /checkin/confirm; a hinted pass only switches to the capture keypad and a no-hint pass stays on Camera. Route every valid scan to the prefilled confirmation form and test hinted and no-hint tokens.

Confirmed: partial Other details produce host: undefined and Confirm remains enabled because host state is not validated. Require either a selected unit or a complete name plus E.164 phone before check-in can submit.

Confirmed: source locale labels and newly written domain/persona docs still surface People/Person despite the explicit User terminology requirement. Update the source-of-truth vocabulary and every user-facing label.

Confirmed: docs/PERSONAS.md points Admin bulk work to /inventory plus units export rather than the new /bulk route and its four tabs. Correct the route-level journey and identify legacy direct routes explicitly if retained.

Confirmed: avatar upload and Site/User preview-job creation do not declare idempotent or replaySafe, and Bulk uses raw requests without stable submission keys. Add payload-scoped submission keys and server replay handling for every new mutation.

Confirmed: avatar keys use a MIME-derived extension and replacement never removes the previous object, so switching formats leaks storage. Delete the superseded object only after the new object and reference commit safely.

findings.summary: Mobile and camera evidence is absent
findings.detail: Confirmed: FEAT records show green automated gates but no real-browser ~390px, keyboard/AT, or shipped getUserMedia/ONNX checkout run, and the branch does not extend e2e coverage. Record the specified mobile browser stories and manual accessibility checks.
